text: Finance Exception Intelligence. From signals to accountable action.
zh: 财务异常智能：从监测信号走向可追踪的行动。

text: See monthly monitor status at a glance. Click the Freight alert. A possible duplicate allocation needs finance review. Identify impacted records, correct the duplication, rerun the scope, and validate Freight and gross profit. Then review revenue, cost, and cost credit trends.
zh: 查看月度监控状态，点击 Freight 预警。可能存在重复分摊，需财务核实。识别受影响记录、修正重复分摊、重新运行并验证 Freight 与毛利；随后查看收入、成本与成本抵减趋势。

text: Now open a separate Service allocation case. GA shows negative month-three gross profit.
zh: 进入独立的 Service allocation 案例：GA 第三个月毛利为负。

text: Ask why gross profit turned negative. Follow the rules, true-up, revenue base, and source evidence.
zh: 询问负毛利原因，依次追踪规则、轧差、收入基数与源凭证。

text: Open the negative revenue voucher. Review the amount, segment, posting user and reference. A matching positive entry is not confirmed in this sample.
zh: 打开负收入凭证，核对金额、segment、入账人和参考号。本样例尚未确认匹配的正向凭证。

text: Compare excluding the voucher from the allocation base only. Posted revenue and months one and two stay unchanged. GA improves, total gross profit is unchanged, and LE remains under review.
zh: 仅从分摊基数排除凭证，保留入账收入及前两个月结果。GA 改善，但总毛利不变，LE 仍待核查。

text: Save the candidate and generate a report with evidence, assumptions, and actions.
zh: 保存候选方案，生成包含证据、假设和行动的报告。

text: Create a follow-up task from the same saved proposal.
zh: 从同一已保存方案创建后续任务。

text: Assign an owner. The assignee receives the task and starts work. Track each handoff.
zh: 分派负责人，由被指派人接收并开始工作，追踪各次交接。

text: Record the outcome. Task completion does not change the ledger.
zh: 记录处理结果；任务完成不改变账务。

text: Ask about report logic. The simulated answer streams from the selected knowledge base and links to its source.
zh: 询问报表逻辑：模拟答案从所选知识库流式展示，并链接原文。

text: Explore built-in rules and personal knowledge libraries.
zh: 查看内置规则和个人知识库。

text: Choose a report, dimension and metric. Describe a monitor, then configure a gross-profit benchmark.
zh: 选择报表、维度和指标，描述监控需求并设置毛利阈值。

text: Add revenue trends, configure signals, rearrange cards, and reuse templates in Monitor Market.
zh: 添加收入趋势、配置信号、拖动卡片，并从 Monitor Market 复用模板。

text: Finance Exception Intelligence. Sample data. Simulated AI.
zh: 财务异常智能。样例数据，模拟 AI。
